sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English podcast. My name is Emily. In this podcast, we speak very slowly.
We use easy English. We repeat important words. Today, we travel to Northern Europe. We go to Sweden.
Our city today is Uppsala. Uppsala is calm. Uppsala is green. Uppsala is full of history and learning.
Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin our journey. Part two, Sweden and Scandinavia.
Sweden is a country in Scandinavia. It is in Northern Europe. Sweden has forests.
Sweden has lakes. Sweden has long winters. People care about nature. People care about balance.
Uppsala is one of the oldest cities in Sweden. It is very important. Part three, where is Uppsala?
Uppsala is north of Stockholm. It is easy to reach by train. The city is not very big. Everything feels close.
There is a river in the city. The river is calm. Nature is near. Green spaces are everywhere. Part four, weather and seasons.
Uppsala has four seasons. Summer is short and bright. Days are long. Autumn is cool and colorful.
Leaves change color. Winter is cold. Snow covers the ground. Spring is fresh and light. The city wakes up again. The seasons change life.
Part five, a city of history. Uppsala has a long history. People lived here many centuries ago. It was an important religious city.
It was an important learning city. Old buildings still stand. They tell quiet stories. History feels calm here.
It is part six, Uppsala Cathedral. Uppsala has a big cathedral. It is very tall. The cathedral is old and beautiful.
People visit from many places. Inside, it is quiet. Light comes through windows. The cathedral watches the city.
Part seven, the university. Uppsala is famous for its university. It is one of the oldest in Europe. Many students live here.
They study and learn. Libraries are important. Knowledge is important. The city feels young and old together.
Part eight, daily life in Uppsala. Daily life in Uppsala is calm. People bike a lot. Cars are not everywhere. Streets feel safe.
People work and study. They enjoy simple moments. Life is balanced. Life is quiet.
Part nine, nature and parks. Uppsala has many parks. People walk and rest. Trees are tall. Grass is green.
In summer, people sit outside. In winter, parks are white. Nature is part of the city. Part ten, food and cafes.
Food in Uppsala is simple. People eat soup and bread. Cafes are popular. People drink coffee. Fika is important. Fika means coffee and talk.
Food and coffee bring people together. Part eleven, silence and light. Uppsala is not loud. There is a lot of silence.
At night, the sky is dark. In summer, the sky stays light. Light changes life. Silence brings peace. The city feels gentle.
Part twelve, feeling, spirit and goodbye. Uppsala is a city of learning, history, nature, silence and balance.
